multi_intent.question: What are the B.Tech CSE eligibility criteria, annual intake, and admission steps at SRGI?
sources: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) Programmes — Comprehensive Overview
SRGI Lucknow Admissions Procedure, Eligibility and Enquiry Channels
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) — Admissions, Academics and Life at SRGI
multi_intent.answer: **B.Tech CSE Eligibility Criteria:** - 10+2 Qualification: Candidates must have passed the 10+2 examination from CBSE, ICSE, UP Board, or any recognized equivalent Board. - Mandatory Subjects: Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects, alongside one optional subject (Chemistry, Biotechnology, Biology, or Technical Vocational subject). - Minimum Qualifying Marks: At least 45% aggregate marks (40% for candidates belonging to SC/ST reserved categories). **B.Tech CSE Annual Intake:** - Sanctioned Annual Intake: 60 Seats. **B.Tech CSE Admission Steps:** 1. **Eligibility Verification:** Ensure you meet the academic and eligibility criteria mentioned above. 2. **Application Submission:** Fill out the SRGI application form available on their official website. 3. **Document Verification:** Gather all required documents such as Domicile Certificate (for U.P. state quota candidates), Transfer Certificate (TC) & Migration Certificate, Character Certificate from the institution last attended, Aadhaar Card copy, and recent passport-sized color photographs. 4. **Admission Process:** Submit the application along with the required documents to the SRGI Admissions Office. 5. **Interview:** Candidates may be called for an interview to assess their suitability for the program. 6. **Notification:** After the selection process, candidates will receive a notification regarding their admission status. For further details, refer to the SRGI Career Pathfinder and Course Selection Simulator or contact the official admission team at +91 9793000005/6/7 or via email at info@srgi.in.

multi_intent.answer: ### Hostel Facilities and Dining Arrangements #### Hostel Facilities S. R. Group of Institutions (SRGI), Lucknow provides hostel facilities for both male and female students. The residential complex offers a secure, disciplined, and comfortable home-like environment for over 2,000+ resident students. Separate, self-contained residential wings are maintained for male and female scholars with round-the-clock administrative oversight. - **Boys' Hostel**: Spacious rooms, 24/7 security, Wi-Fi connectivity, and a mess. - **Girls' Hostel**: Also includes spacious rooms, 24/7 security, Wi-Fi connectivity, and a mess. #### Dining Arrangements The campus dining services offer a diverse menu of wholesome North and South Indian vegetarian meals, continental snacks, fresh juices, and hot beverages. The dining area is expansive and well-ventilated, accommodating hundreds of diners simultaneously. ### Transport Options #### Campus Transit S. R. Group of Institutions (SRGI), Lucknow provides a range of transport options for students, including: - **College-operated transit fleets**: These fleets serve students and staff across Lucknow city and adjoining regions, ensuring seamless connectivity. - **Bus pass allocations**: Students can obtain bus passes for daily commuting, which are managed by the transport fleet. - **Daily transit operations**: The transport fleet operates daily schedules, ensuring convenient and reliable transportation for students. #### Emergency Contacts For any emergencies or transport-related issues, students can contact the following emergency numbers: - **Campus Security & Anti-Ragging Helpline**: +91 8417000011 (Dr. Shashank Singh (Chief Proctor)) - **Campus Transit Dispatch Emergency**: +91 9793000099 (Mr. Devesh Singh (Chief Transport Officer)) - **Hostel Residential Emergency**: +91 9793000090 (Mr. K.M. multi_intent.answer: For B.Tech programmes at S. R. Group of Institutions (SRGI), Lucknow, the admission requirements and tuition fees vary based on the specific programme and specialization. For the core B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering programme, the annual intake is 180 seats. Specialized tracks like Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (60 seats), Artificial Intelligence (60 seats), and Data Science (60 seats) are also offered. Tuition fees for B.Tech programmes are not specified in the provided evidence, and specific fees for each programme and specialization are not detailed. However, SRGI Lucknow offers merit-based admissions through state-level counselling (UPTAC / AKTU) based on JEE Main scores for B.Tech, CUET-PG for MBA, or respective state entrance examination rankings. Direct institutional merit admission is also available through the online portal or at the campus admission cell under the management / vacant seats quota as per regulatory norms. For detailed information on tuition fees, one should refer to the official prospectus or contact SRGI Lucknow directly.
